title: Building an MCP Server: Stateless Python and TypeScript
service: notesrv: a stateless MCP 2026-07-28 notes server with a note directory, a stdio loop and an isolated 2025-11-25 door

parts.lesson_anchor: Request validation; Resources; Prompts; Every successful result is typed; code/main.py dispatch and complete, code/main.ts isValidRequestId; The modern dispatch loop: identify notifications before request validation and never respond
planted_bugs: note_id_from_uri uses str.lstrip('notes://'), which strips a set of characters; it surfaces two calls up as -32602 Resource not found for a note that exists
complete() defaults cache_scope to public, against its docstring, so resources/read marks a user's note public
handle_prompts_get adds ttlMs and cacheScope, although only discovery, list and read results are cacheable
handle answers an id-less notification with a missing-id JSON-RPC error instead of returning no response before request validation
MemoryNotes.create scans every id for the maximum, O(n) per create, and reuses the newest id after it is deleted
parts.timing_assert: 7000 creates under 0.12 s (the scanning version takes about 1.5 s, the counter about 3 ms)
parts.overfix_guard: after deleting a middle note and the newest note, two new notes get ids never issued before, which rules out len(notes) + 1 and recomputing the maximum on delete; tools/list stays public, which rules out making every cacheable result private; an error for a request with a valid id carries that id, which rules out sending every error with a null id; supplied id checks preserve bool rejection, safe-integer endpoints and error-id correlation. Notifications remain unanswered for a known method, unknown method and malformed params; present id 0 or an empty string is still a request.
parts.deviation: Id generation belongs to MemoryNotes.create because tools/call is Part 3 work. URI extraction gives a failure two calls from its root cause; the five debugging defects include notification dispatch. The timing uses 7000 ordinary creates so the quadratic scan stays within roughly three seconds.
parts.implementation_boundary: valid_request_id is fully supplied: bool is not an integer and integer ids obey the JavaScript safe range. Candidate repairs URI extraction, cache scope, prompt cache hints, notification dispatch and monotonic note identities.

parts.lesson_anchor: The Problem: the application keeps durable notes; Resources: notes:// URIs that clients cache
parts.exactness: each body file holds exactly the body's UTF-8 bytes (CRLF, lone CR, trailing spaces, no final newline, empty body, emoji); titles, tags and a None owner come back unchanged after a reopen

parts.deviation: The lesson has no natural tree or DAG, so Part 5 is the state machine of a dual-era server: one handshake state per connection, beside a stateless modern core. notifications/initialized is sent but its reply is not asserted.
